changes: No changes to persons, relations or date. Checked that VS 1820 and ŚS 1685 agree (both give 1763 CE). Expanded the notes.

notes: The colophon is dated in two eras, saṃvat (VS) 1820 and Śaka 1685. They agree: 1820−57 = 1685+78 = 1763 CE. The date is the new-moon day (amāvāsyā, tithi 30) of the dark half of Āṣāḍha, a Sunday, which falls around mid-1763. The cataloguer marked the closing words '†śigipaṃ bhuṃjiṣāḍema†' as corrupt. They may be a scribe's name written in a letter-substitution code, which scribes sometimes used. I could not decode it, so I have recorded no person.
